events.info: There's nothing more special than sharing Disney magic with loved ones. Whether it's the first time you watched Toy Story, sang along to Let It Go, or cheered for your favorite Disney Princess, Disney On Ice is the perfect place to revisit cherished memories and create new ones together. Mickey, Minnie, Donald, and Goofy will take you on a journey through these unforgettable moments, powered by a Magical MousePad. Discover thrilling adventures from Zootopia, Inside Out 2, and the all-new Moana 2. Relive the timeless tales of Toy Story, Frozen, and Encanto, and the dazzling Disney Princesses. And hold on tight as Stitch grabs the Magical MousePad and shakes things up! Feel the excitement in an enchanted celebration close to home, only at Disney On Ice! *Note: Costumes not permitted for guests 14 years & older. Visit DisneyOnIce.com for more information.
events.pleaseNote: - All guests age 2 & older are required to have a ticket. - No costumes for guests 14 & older. - Please monitor the venue website for venue policies, including health and safety protocols, which are subject to change. - All tickets are subject to availability. - Prices are subject to change. - Visit DisneyOnIce.com for more event info and Ticket Terms and Conditions.

Or guests may carry one opaque clutch-sized purse or wallet, not exceeding 4.5 inches tall by 6.5 inches long. Bags that do not meet these guidelines must be discarded or returned to a vehicle. CHI Health Center staff members are not permitted to hold or store bags on the premises. Cameras and recording devices are not allowed in the facility, but may vary on an event by event basis. Please contact Box Office for more information. Outside food or beverage is not allowed. CHI Health Center Omaha is a smoke free facility. Patrons may be subject to security checks.
generalInfo.childRule: For most events everyone needs a ticket. For shows intended for young audiences please check event or call the Box Office regarding ages allowed on lap.

events.name: Harlem Globetrotters MVP Court Pass
events.info: THIS IS AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE. TICKET TO THE MAIN EVENT IS ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer than courtside with the MVP Court Pass! Join the Fan Tunnel to welcome the Harlem Globetrotters to the floor, step into the Pre-Game Huddle, warm up with the team, and watch the famous Globetrotters Magic Circle from just feet away. This is MVP access on another level, and the perfect way to make a memory you'll talk about for years to come. With just 16 passes per game, this is the most exclusive 20 minutes in the arena. Check in at the announcer's table 30 mins prior to the game start. Late arrivals will not be refunded. All participants must have their own MVP Court Pass - no exceptions. Children under 10 must be with an adult who also has an MVP Court Pass. Soft or rubber-soled shoes required. This premium upgrade is not included with your game ticket. Don't miss your chance to be part of the Rivalry as an MVP!

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: To purchase tickets, please call Ticketmaster at 800-745-3000
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Monday - Friday, 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM Evening, weekend, and holiday hours vary according to event schedules.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cash, Visa, MasterCard, Discover, & American Express
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call will open 2 hours prior to an event. Customer must present the credit card used to make the purchase, as well as a valid photo ID. Tickets will only be given to the person whose name is on the order.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking at arena is free; Multiple lots surrounding arena; Parking garage across the street
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: WHEELCHAIR ACCESS: Accessible seating is located in both the upper and lower bowl. HEARING IMPAIRED: Assistive Listening Devices are available at the Guest Services table on the south side of the main concourse. A valid ID is required to ensure the return of equipment. ELEVATOR ACCESS: Elevators are located at each entrance. The elevator nearest the south entrance provides access to the ground level and first floor, while the elevator nearest the north entrance provides access to the ground level, first and second floors.

generalInfo.generalRule: DOORS OPEN: 1 hour prior to event CAMERAS: For most events, small point and shoot cameras are allowed. Professional cameras, specifically cameras with professional/detachable lenses and flash, are not permitted. Baxter Arena reserves the right to examine and prohibit the use of any camera entering the venue. RECORDING DEVICES: Audio and video recording is prohibited during all events.
generalInfo.childRule: Most events do not require a ticket for children under the age of two. However, in order for a child to have their own seat, a ticket will be required. Note that some shows intended for young children require all attendees to have a ticket. To inquire about specific events, please call 402.554.6200.

events.name: Harlem Globetrotters: Rivalry Tour

presales.name: Citi® Cardmember Presale
presales.description: To access the sale, use the first 6 digits of your eligible Citi® credit card or Citibank Debit Card as your presale code. You will also need to use your Citi® card to successfully complete your purchase.

events.info: Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court - hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron.. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric, and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now.
events.pleaseNote: A warning to any fans with light sensitivity that strobing effects will be used during light shows within the Harlem Globetrotters game. By purchasing this ticket, you give permission to use your likeness.
